lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajaamal kau a(n)t kaal mahi naaraain sudh aaee ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) gat kau jogeesur baachhat so gat chhin mahi paaee ||2||
lines.translation: that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh bidiaa dharam kaun gaj keenaa ||
lines.translation: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has he performed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak birad raam kaa dekhahu abhai daan tih deenaa ||3||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਕਉਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadho kaun jugat ab keejai ||
lines.translation: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te duramat sagal binaasai raam bhagat man bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man maaiaa mahi urajh rahio hai boojhai nah kachh giaanaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun naam jag jaa kai simarai paavai pad nirabaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state of Nirvaanaa? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae daiaal kripaal sa(n)t jan tab ih baat bataaee ||
lines.translation: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sarab dharam maano tih keee jih prabh keerat gaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religious rituals. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam nar nis baasur mahi nimakh ek ur dhaarai ||
lines.translation: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jam ko traas mitai naanak tih apuno janam savaarai ||3||2||
lines.translation: - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee naaraain sudh lehi ||
lines.translation: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhin chhin audh ghatai nis baasur brithaa jaat hai deh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taranaapo bikhian siu khoio baalapan agiaanaa ||
lines.translation: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝੈ ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: biradh bhaio ajahoo nahee samajhai kaun kumat urajhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness in which you are entangled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam deeo jih thaakur so tai kiu bisaraaio ||
lines.translation: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukat hot nar jaa kai simarai nimakh na taa kau gaaio ||2||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa ko mad kahaa karat hai sa(n)g na kaahoo jaaee ||
lines.translation: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman hoi hai a(n)t sahaaee ||3||3||81||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires, who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee cha(n)d chaRahi se taare soee dineear tapat rahai ||
lines.translation: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa dharatee so paun jhulaare jug jee khele thaav kaise ||1||
lines.translation: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar ||
lines.translation: Give up your attachment to life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovai paravaanaa karahi dhingaanaa kal lakhan veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kitai des na aaiaa suneeai teerath paas na baithaa ||
lines.translation: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at any sacred shrine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: daataa daan kare tah naahee mahal usaar na baithaa ||2||
lines.translation: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion he has built. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko sat kare so chheejai tap ghar tap na hoee ||
lines.translation: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home of the sincere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ ਬਦਨਾਵੀ ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je ko naau lae badanaavee kal ke lakhan eee ||3||
lines.translation: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis sikadaaree tisahi khuaaree chaakar kehe daranaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaa sikadaarai pavai ja(n)jeeree taa chaakar hathahu maranaa ||4||
lines.translation: when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4||
